verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can export content at any time (anytype-docs-20) in Markdown or Any-Block format (anytype-docs-11), and that all channels can be exported (anytype-docs-23). A localhost API with a published OpenAPI spec offers a further programmatic path to pull data out (anytype-docs-1, anytype-supp-openapi-v2). Missing for 10: no documentation of how faithfully Markdown export preserves databases, relations, Types and files; no evidence that Any-Block is an open, documented format; no independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export-and-leave workflow.
